title: storetax.created
description: Triggered when a store tax is created. Generated from https://docs.salla.dev/webhook-events/store (fetched 2026-10-26).

event.description: A label or title used to identify a specific event

merchant.description: Merchant ID who installed the application on their store. Get details on the Merchant via the ID  using the endpoint [here](https://docs.salla.dev/api-8330089)

created_at.description: The date and time when a particular Webhook was created or initiated.

id.description: A unique identifier assigned to a specific store.

status.description: The condition or classification of an entity or transaction with respect to taxation.

country.description: The specific country or jurisdiction where taxes are levied, collected, and regulated in relation to a particular entity or transaction
